entities.name: City of Urborg
entities.description: A gothic citadel on the island of Urborg, ruled by the lich Nevinyrral and obliterated by his disk.

entities.name: Nevinyrral
entities.description: Lich king and necromancer who ruled Urborg and destroyed it with his Disk.

entities.name: Nevinyrral's Disk
entities.description: Disk-shaped phylactery into which Nevinyrral poured his essence to destroy Urborg.

entities.name: Bogardan
entities.description: Volcanic realm ruled by godlike beings of flame; at war with Urborg.

entities.name: Dark Age
entities.description: Era in which Nevinyrral ruled Urborg.

events.summary: Nevinyrral launches an unprovoked campaign against Bogardan.
events.quote: launch an unprovoked campaign against Bogardan

events.summary: Bogardan retaliates with hellkites and triggers a volcanic eruption beneath Urborg.
events.quote: sending flights of hellkites to darken the skies over Urborg

events.summary: Nevinyrral pours his essence into Nevinyrral's Disk and detonates it, obliterating the city.
events.quote: he poured his essence into a disk-shaped phylactery

relations.quote: Urborg was ruled by the infamous lich king Nevinyrral
It was at war with Bogardan
